function.name: LOAD_FNT
function.abstract: It recovers of disk any type of FNT font

description.p: This function recovers any type of letter of disk from an archive in binary format FNT, own of Fenix. That archives hold non-sizable fonts where each character is a graph of 2, 256 or 65536 colours. The FNT of 8 bits (256 colours) hold the palette of colours used by the archive.
LOAD_FNT returns an entire number that identifies to the font on memory. It can be used that code to write text with functions like .
LOAD_FNT can recover any type of letter in format FNT of DIV Games Studio.
